questions.q: In the production of patterns, how is a 'motif' best defined?
options: The wooden frame used for screen printing.
A single, foundational design unit that is repeated to create a continuous pattern.
The space left blank between two colors.
A large canvas painting of a landscape.
questions.explain: A motif is the core element or single unit of a design. When a motif is repeated systematically over a surface, it forms a pattern.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: A motif created using shapes such as intersecting triangles, squares, and circles is classified as a:
questions.explain: Geometrical motifs are designs constructed using mathematical shapes like circles, rectangles, zig-zags, and polygons.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which type of motif heavily relies on imagery from leaves, stems, and trees?
questions.explain: Plant motifs derive their visual inspiration directly from the forms and structures of vegetation such as leaves, vines, and branches.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: The Arewa knot or the Adinkra symbols of West Africa are excellent examples of which kind of motif?
questions.explain: Traditional motifs are design units passed down through generations that carry significant cultural, historical, or religious meanings, such as the Arewa knot in Northern Nigeria.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which of the following is a primary application or use of motifs in everyday design?
options: Decorating borders of documents and making greeting cards
questions.explain: Motifs are frequently used to create decorative borders, design visually appealing greeting cards, and produce textile prints.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
